PLAN "12-Week Post-Meniscus Strength for Ski Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and knee resilience for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Protection" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower focus - knee-friendly":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 7m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full body - control":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
